description: The facts of one cadastral unit (a flat, house, shop, parking space): use, surfaces, floor and floor position, building, energy certificate (letter, kWh/m², CO₂), tourist licences, and with the scope unacasa.valuation the sale and rent estimates, the Catastro reference value and the yearly IBI estimate. include_parcel adds the facts of its parcel. Each field has value, unit and src (a key of the sources table of the answer: name, provider, licence); fields without a value are counted (counts.without_value), not listed. A large answer comes in parts: next_cursor gives the next part (same arguments + cursor). Each answer starts with cite_as: the source line with the link of the unacasa page.

cursor.description: next_cursor of the previous part, with the same other arguments

groups.description: unit, energy, valuation, and with include_parcel the parcel groups

include_parcel.description: add the facts of the unit's parcel (default false)

name: get_unit_facts
title: Unit facts
